title: Agentic Security Operations Platform console: data sources and outegrations, administration and analytics

prose.text: Data sources, outegrations and data management are in [[unified.secops-platform.data]]; administration, analytics and Admin Portal access and navigation in [[unified.secops-platform.console]]. The platform's positioning is in [[portfolio.secops-platform]], and the products that run on it in [[soc-workbench.overview]], [[uvm.overview]] and [[aem.overview]].
